meta.name: prioritize
meta.description: Choose up to three immediate priorities from competing initiatives. Use when everything is urgent and the customer needs a defensible order with explicit deferrals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一堆都喊紧急的事项排出先后,明确先做哪几件、哪些暂缓
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上事情都标着紧急,却需要给出一份站得住脚的先后顺序
copy.tagline_en: Rank competing initiatives into a defensible order and name what gets deferred
copy.fit_line_en: For you if everything feels urgent and you need a defensible order for what comes first

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从多个互相竞争的待办事项里选出最多三个「马上要做」的优先级,并明确列出哪些被推迟,给出一个有依据、说得清理由的先后顺序。它先读任务上下文契约和方法说明再动手。
howto.when: 当所有事情都显得紧急、你需要一份站得住脚的先后顺序并明确说明推迟了什么时触发。若由 @fde 调用,会沿用当前的已脱敏材料与范围,不重新走一遍设置和提问。

say.text: 这几件事都很急,帮我定最多三个马上做的
say.note: 会给出排序并点名被推迟的事项

say.text: 按优先级排一下,并说明哪些先不做、为什么
say.note: 产出含明确推迟项的可辩护顺序

say.text: 告诉我先做哪三件,其余推迟的理由写清楚
say.note: 上限三项,其余列入推迟

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude picks up to three immediate priorities from competing initiatives and names the deferrals, giving a defensible order. It reads the task context contract and method first.
howto.when_en: Use when everything looks urgent and you need a defensible order with explicit deferrals. If called by @fde it reuses the current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting discovery.

say_en.text: Everything's urgent - pick up to three things to do now
say_en.note: Returns an order and names the deferrals

say_en.text: Rank these by priority and say what we're not doing yet
Tell me the first three, with reasons for deferring the rest
